in_sanskrit.name: Sharveek
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharveek एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the protector and preserver of the gods, Sharveek is a name that carries the weight of divine power and strength. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which means 'Lord of the Gods', this name is perfect for a child who is destined for greatness and leadership.
